risk-of-bias.support-for-judgement:
Subjects were assigned to treatments, (allocated 1:1; BAN2401:placebo), based on a computer-generated randomization scheme that was reviewed and approved by an independent statistician.
Randomization was performed centrally by an IxRS (INTERACTIVE voice and web response system. The IxRS or clinical supply vendor generated the randomized blister card identification numbers. At enrollment (and after
successful completion of Visit 1 and Visit 2), the investigator or designee called the IxRS to register the subject information. At randomization (Visit 3), the IxRS assigned each subject a unique 6-digit randomization number
